mapper.select: SELECT emp01_person_id AS person_id, emp01_company_id AS company_id, emp01_emp_no AS emp_no, emp01_kor_nm AS kor_nm, emp01_hire_date AS hire_date, emp01_order_seq AS order_seq, emp01_email_addr AS email_addr, emp01_office_telno AS office_telno, emp01_office_detail AS office_detail, emp01_mobile_telno AS mobile_telno, emp01_note AS note FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id = #{personId} AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp01_person (emp01_person_id, emp01_company_id, emp01_emp_no, emp01_kor_nm, emp01_hire_date, emp01_order_seq, emp01_email_addr, emp01_office_telno, emp01_office_detail, emp01_mobile_telno, emp01_note) VALUES (#{personId}, #{companyId}, #{empNo}, #{korNm}, #{hireDate}, #{orderSeq}, #{emailAddr}, #{officeTelno}, #{officeDetail}, #{mobileTelno}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE emp01_person SET emp01_kor_nm = #{korNm}, emp01_hire_date = #{hireDate}, emp01_order_seq = #{orderSeq}, emp01_email_addr = #{emailAddr}, emp01_office_telno = #{officeTelno}, emp01_office_detail = #{officeDetail}, emp01_mobile_telno = #{mobileTelno}, emp01_note = #{note} WHERE emp01_person_id = #{personId} AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select:
SELECT count(*) FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = emp01_company_id WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(sys01_company_nm , emp01_kor_nm , f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') , emp01_office_telno , emp01_mobile_telno)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= f_today() ) AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800')
AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId}
AND sys01_use_yn = 'true'
AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('900')

SELECT emp01_person_id AS person_id, sys01_company_nm AS company_nm, emp01_kor_nm AS kor_nm, emp01_emp_no AS emp_no, f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'pos_nm') AS pos_nm, emp01_office_telno AS office_tel_no, emp01_mobile_telno AS mobile_tel_no FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = emp01_company_id WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(sys01_company_nm, emp01_kor_nm, emp01_office_telno, emp01_mobile_telno)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) AND CAST(emp01_company_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE #{companyId} AND emp01_person_id IN #{id} ORDER BY sys01_company_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" ASC, emp01_kor_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" ASC
